decisions.reason: As a close-to-core custom hearing product, A benefits from accumulated development effort and strategic fit, so management is likely to continue backing it and read any weaker signals as temporary.
C has visible prior commitment through its own product page and fits the firm's equipment and workflow-efficiency logic, which makes withdrawal in the next year unlikely.

Although D is distant from the firm's established offer, its recent launch and dedicated presentation create pressure to justify the investment a bit longer before admitting the diversification failed.

E is close to the firm's digital production direction and certified equipment capabilities, so management is inclined to retain it while attributing any early underperformance to normal ramp-up effects.
